youtube.title: Lucia did time. She's the woman you'll play in GTA 6
youtube.description: Lucia did time in Leonida Penitentiary for fighting for her family; Rockstar's answer to how she got out is, more or less, luck. With Jason she forms a criminal couple, Bonnie and Clyde, Florida style, and she is the series' first female lead who isn't optional; GTA 6 is scheduled for November 19th. Facts checked against Wikipedia (Grand Theft Auto VI) and search summaries of Rockstar's character text; no Rockstar page was readable.

tiktok.caption: Lucia did time. She's the woman you'll play in GTA 6, the series' first female lead who isn't optional. Coming November 19th.
